components.name: File Drop Portal
components.description: Primary local-file action during loading and compact chrome after readiness.
components.css: .ds-drop-portal { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; min-width: 16rem; padding: .72rem .85rem; border: 1px dashed rgba(245,238,228,.32); border-radius: 13px; color: var(--ink); background: rgba(9,11,17,.84); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.22); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.1); cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-drop-portal:hover, .ds-drop-portal:focus-within { border-color: var(--warm); background: rgba(23,20,18,.82); outline: none; } .ds-drop-portal svg { width: 1.35rem; fill: none; stroke: var(--warm); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-drop-portal span { display: grid; gap: .18rem; } .ds-drop-portal strong { font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-drop-portal small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .67rem; } .ds-file-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Showcase Choice
components.css: .ds-showcase-choice { display: grid; gap: .3rem; min-width: 0; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--edge); color: var(--ink); text-align: left; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-showcase-choice:hover, .ds-showcase-choice:focus-visible { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); outline: none; } .ds-showcase-choice:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); } .ds-showcase-choice span { font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-showcase-choice small { color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: .61rem; }

components.name: Selected Showcase Choice
components.description: Active bundled example, expressed as a full amber cell.
components.css: .ds-showcase-choice { display: grid; gap: .3rem; min-width: 0; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; border: 0; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-showcase-choice.ds-is-selected, .ds-showcase-choice.ds-is-selected:hover, .ds-showcase-choice.ds-is-selected:focus-visible { color: #18120c; background: var(--warm); outline: none; } .ds-showcase-choice span { font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-showcase-choice small { color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: .61rem; } .ds-showcase-choice.ds-is-selected small { color: #3c2d1d; }

components.name: Viewer Dock
components.description: Bottom-anchored glass chrome for example selection and live readout.
components.html:
GEODE OUTCROP
PENDULUM WAVE
READY · 60 FPS
components.css: .ds-viewer-dock { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)) minmax(10rem,.76fr); max-width: 68rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--edge); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07); color: var(--ink); background: var(--panel); box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.34); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.12); font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-dock-choice, .ds-dock-readout { padding: 1rem 1.1rem; } .ds-dock-choice { border-right: 1px solid var(--edge); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-dock-readout { align-self: center; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: .58rem; }

components.name: Status Readout
components.description: Compact runtime state and interaction telemetry.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-status-readout { display: grid; gap: .34rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); } .ds-status-readout p { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: .5rem; margin: 0; font-size: .7rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-status-dot { flex: 0 0 auto; width: .42rem; height: .42rem; margin-top: .28rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #9fd08a; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(159,208,138,.65); } .ds-telemetry { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: .75rem; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: .58rem; } .ds-status-readout small { color: var(--faint); font-size: .59rem; }

narrative.overview:
The rendered Three.js asset owns the viewport. Compact controls sit at the perimeter as translucent, low-contrast chrome, preserving a direct relationship between the user and the live scene.

Warm editorial display type gives the workspace character; restrained sans-serif controls and monospaced telemetry keep it technical. Amber is a scarce interaction signal, while ivory neutrals carry hierarchy without competing with the asset.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed live stage with compact perimeter chrome.
Warm editorial headlines paired with precise technical readouts.
One amber accent reserved for interaction and active state.

rules.name: The Amber Signal Rule
rules.body: Use amber only for actions, progress, and active selection; its rarity keeps state unmistakable.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use editorial serif for identity, sans-serif for action, and monospace only for technical metadata.

rules.name: The Stage Owns the Screen Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays at the perimeter and never becomes a competing central panel once the asset is ready.

rules.name: The Bounded Glass Rule
rules.body: Every blurred surface needs a visible edge or shadow so it remains legible over unknown asset imagery.

dos: Do keep the rendered asset visible behind every piece of chrome.
Do use amber for interactive focus, progress, and selected state.
Do preserve the serif/sans/mono role split at compact sizes.
donts: Don't turn amber into a general decorative fill.
Don't round the dock or showcase cells; curvature identifies file-drop interactions.
Don't add central chrome after loading that competes with orbiting the asset.
